items.title: Fixed-level angular degree sum

source.anchor: §4.1.1 Eq. (14)–(15) and the adjacent component and joint coefficient laws; implicit uncut finite-sum consequence
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, CC BY 4.0. Samplinglib reconstruction of an implicit consequence, not a separately numbered source theorem.

items.statement: Fix a level i and deterministic unit vectors u_i,…,u_h. Let the tensor coefficients at all levels and allowed degrees have their unconditioned joint standard Gaussian law. The actual angular polynomial at level i, obtained by summing its degree components at those directions, is centered Gaussian with variance n times the sum of the squared source amplitudes.
assumptions: The dimension n is a positive integer, h is a natural depth, and 0≤i≤h. The paper fixes h from sufficiently large n; the isolated identity does not use that relation and does not enlarge the admissible hard family.
The trailing directions u_j are deterministic and satisfy ‖u_j‖₂=1. The source uses the even degree set from 4 through P; repetitions in the ordered tensor are kept.

The randomness is the unconditioned standard Gaussian on the full Euclidean coefficient direct sum, with the product of block laws derived from the existing coefficient theorem. The spatial input and any adaptive or conditioned coefficient laws are not involved.

formulae.label: Source degrees and amplitudes
formulae.tex: K=2^{74(h+1)},\quad P=2^{64(h+1)},\quad \mathcal P=\{4,6,\ldots,P\},\quad S_i=\sum_{j=0}^{h-i}K^j,\qquad a_{i,p}=\frac{1}{p^4 S_i^2\sqrt{(h-i+1)\log(2PS_i)}}.

formulae.label: Exact uncut angular law
formulae.tex: \begin{gathered}\psi_i=u_i\otimes u_{i+1}^{\otimes K}\otimes\cdots\otimes u_h^{\otimes K^{h-i}},\\ F_i^\Xi(u)=\sum_{p\in\mathcal P}\sqrt n\,a_{i,p}\langle\Xi_{i,p},\psi_i^{\otimes p}\rangle,\\ \Xi\sim\mathcal N(0,I_{\mathcal G_n})\quad\Longrightarrow\quad F_i^\Xi(u)\sim\mathcal N\!\left(0,n\sum_{p\in\mathcal P}a_{i,p}^2\right).\end{gathered}

obligations.label: Use the actual projected coefficient blocks and source degree components
Derive the exact centered Gaussian law of their sum

bindings.boundary: One uncut level at deterministic unit directions under the actual unconditioned coefficient law. Radial and zero-block fields, adaptive evaluations, multi-point covariance, conditional level iteration, normalizer moments and all main query lower bounds remain open.

assumption_deltas.source: The hard family uses sufficiently large n and a specified depth.
assumption_deltas.lean: Every positive integer n and natural h for this isolated law.
assumption_deltas.reason: Finite independent Gaussian addition needs no asymptotic regime; admissibility and the lower bounds do.

assumption_deltas.source: Fixed unit trailing directions, ordered coefficient tensors, and the unconditioned joint Gaussian.
assumption_deltas.lean: The exact sphere hypotheses, finite ordered carriers and flat stdGaussian measure.
assumption_deltas.reason: The finite degree index includes P, and projecting tagged coordinates changes neither values nor variance.

assumption_deltas.source: Independent coefficient blocks and fixed-direction scalar component laws.
assumption_deltas.lean: No independence, moment or measurability premise on the angular sum.
assumption_deltas.reason: The checked product law and scalar law derive these properties in the proof. The variance's toNNReal coercion is exact because the sum of squares times n is nonnegative.
